Data.UnitTalk_KOR: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(이)가 어중간하게 끝내고 싶지 않다며, 훈련을 재개하길 원한다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> doesn't want to leave things halfway and is asking to continue training.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、中途半端に終わらせるのは嫌だと、トレーニングの再開を求めている。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>说她不想半途而废，希望能继续训练。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>說她不想半途而廢，希望能繼續訓練。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ne veut pas laisser les choses en suspens et demande de reprendre l'entraînement.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: „<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> möchte die Dinge nicht halbfertig lassen und bittet darum, das Training fortzusetzen.“
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> no quiere dejar las cosas a medias y pide continuar el entrenamiento.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> não quer deixar as coisas pela metade e pede para continuar o treinamento.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>ไม่ต้องการปล่อยให้เรื่องค้างคา จึงขอฝึกต่อค่ะ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tidak ingin meninggalkan sesuatu setengah-setengah dan meminta untuk melanjutkan pelatihan.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> không muốn bỏ dở giữa chừng và yêu cầu tiếp tục huấn luyện.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> चीज़ों को अधूरा नहीं छोड़ना चाहती और ट्रेनिंग जारी रखने का अनुरोध कर रही है।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: We can make up for it next time.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: じゃあ、もう少し頑張ってみる？
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Je me rattraperai la prochaine fois !
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Ich mache es beim nächsten Mal wieder gut!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ไว้คราวหน้าจะชดเชยให้ก็แล้วกัน!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Lần sau bù lại là được mà!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: मैं अगली बार इसकी भरपाई कर दूँगी!

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: Then let's give it another try.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: その分、次に頑張ればいいよ！
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Alors, on essaie un peu plus fort ?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Sollen wir uns dann noch ein bisschen mehr anstrengen?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Então, vamos tentar um pouco mais?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: งั้นเรามาพยายามกันอีกหน่อยดีไหม?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_IND: Kalau begitu, bagaimana kalau kita berusaha sedikit lebih keras?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Vậy chúng ta cố gắng thêm chút nữa nhé?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: तो क्या हम थोड़ी और कोशिश करें?

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: 活力ポーションを渡す。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: Le da una poción de vitalidad.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: มอบยาเพิ่มพลังงานให้
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Đưa cho một Bình Hoạt Lực.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: एक जीवन शक्ति औषधि देती है।

Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、すっきりした表情で笑った。
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> sonrió, con una expresión de alivio.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>ยิ้มอย่างสดชื่นค่ะ
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ताज़गी भरी मुस्कान के साथ मुस्कुराई।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> laughed awkwardly, saying today just wasn't her day.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、日を改めようと気恥ずかしそうにした。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>说今天运气不好，显得有些尴尬。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>說今天運氣不好，顯得有些尷尬。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> s'est montré gêné, disant que ce n'était pas son jour.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> lachte verlegen und sagte, heute sei einfach nicht ihr Tag.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se rio con incomodidad, diciendo que hoy no era su día.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> riu sem jeito, dizendo que hoje não era o dia dela.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>หัวเราะอย่างเขิน ๆ และบอกว่าวันนี้ไม่ใช่วันของเธอค่ะ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> merasa malu karena mengatakan hari ini bukan hari mereka.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> cười ngượng nghịu, nói rằng hôm nay không phải ngày của cô ấy.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> अजीब तरह से हँसी, यह कहते हुए कि आज उसका दिन नहीं था।

Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>พยักหน้าอย่างเข้าใจค่ะ

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> frowned, her expression tinged with disappointment.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、残念そうに顔をしかめた。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> fronça les sourcils, son expression empreinte de déception.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> runzelte die Stirn, ihr Ausdruck war von Enttäuschung geprägt.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> frunció el ceño, su expresión teñida de decepción.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> franziu a testa, sua expressão cheia de decepção.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>ขมวดคิ้ว สีหน้าของเธอเจือด้วยความผิดหวังค่ะ
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> cau mày, vẻ mặt lộ rõ sự thất vọng.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने निराशा से भरी अभिव्यक्ति के साथ भौंहें सिकोड़ीं।

Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>ยิ้มพร้อมกล่าวขอบคุณค่ะ
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> mỉm cười, nói lời cảm ơn.
